policies.name: Production Model Authorization
policies.rule: Production model status must be APPROVED in Model Registry

policies.name: Data Quality Contract
policies.rule: No silent zero default allowed for missing spatial data; 38/38 districts required

policies.name: Knowledge Base Integrity
policies.rule: Published KB document chunks must match SHA-256 checksum in RAG Registry

policies.name: Decision Lineage Integrity
policies.rule: Every decision must contain complete 19-node version graph context hash

policies.name: Quantum Advantage Scientific Guardrail
policies.rule: QAOA result must contain classical MILP benchmark and label Quantum Advantage: NOT ESTABLISHED when gap = 0.4700

policies.name: Zero Secret Leakage
policies.rule: Zero hardcoded high-entropy secrets or private API keys in codebase

policies.name: Database Backup Compliance
policies.rule: Database backup age must not exceed 24 hours (RPO SLA)
